protocol.selection: All validation records; pair(random.Random(record.id)); sorted source then id
protocol.candidates: All same-source validation targets, including duplicate targets
protocol.positives: Exact training positive_mask; normalized answers or overlapping image/caption keys
protocol.ties: First candidate in record-id order, exactly as training validation
protocol.types: Question/source-only heuristic v1; not official question-type annotation

model_download.scope: Official files downloaded and hashed only; inference reproduction pending; remote code not executed.

provenance.scope: Pinned official model and pooling, 65536-pixel resource-constrained track; not official default resolution
provenance.vision_errors: Fail closed; never silently replace image inputs with NULL

qa_paired_delta.unit: query/image within each source; 5000 paired resamples; unadjusted intervals

control: Only query images removed; identical frozen target vectors and candidates. Caption sources excluded from text-only QA score.
